service: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) WMTS

use.vi: Chỉ để hiển thị quả địa cầu 3D. Màu ô ảnh không phải số đo; không đọc giá trị từ màu.
use.en: Visualisation for the 3D globe only. Tile colours are not measurements; never read values from them.

acknowledgement: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).

data_use_policy.statement: NASA promotes full and open sharing of data (GIBS docs, linking to the Earthdata data use guidance).
data_use_policy.fetch_status: HTTP 403 to automated requests on 2026-11-14; not re-read here

url_pattern: https://gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov/wmts/{epsg}/best/{Layer}/default/{Time}/{TileMatrixSet}/{z}/{y}/{x}.{ext}  ({Time} segment omitted for layers without a time dimension; Time = YYYY-MM-DD or the 'default' value)

layers.title: Blue Marble Shaded Relief and Bathymetry (MODIS)
Corrected Reflectance (True Color, VIIRS, Suomi NPP)
At Sensor Radiance (Day/Night Band, VIIRS, Suomi NPP)
Surface Soil Moisture (L4, 12z Instantaneous, Model Value-Added, SMAP)
Root Zone Soil Moisture (L4, 12z Instantaneous, Model Value-Added, SMAP)

notes: The 'best' endpoint serves the best available version of each layer.
EPSG:3857 layers use GoogleMapsCompatible_LevelN tile matrix sets (256 px, XYZ order z/y/x).
EPSG:4326 layers use 512 px tiles on a geographic grid; max zoom differs from the 3857 set.
Daily layers can have gaps; use a date inside the listed periods or the default.
